title.zh: 【英国银行曾在 90 天内收到逾 1 万起加密转账受阻投诉】
title.en: 【英国银行曾在 90 天内收到逾 1 万起加密转账受阻投诉】

current_state.zh: Stand With Crypto reported over 10,000 UK complaints in 90 days from customers whose crypto transfers were blocked or restricted by banks, and urged regulators to replace blanket restrictions with risk-based case reviews.
